description: TS 5.0 array `extends` combining a shared monorepo base with a generated config that owns `paths` + `include` — the shape SvelteKit (`.svelte-kit/tsconfig.json`) and WXT (`.wxt/tsconfig.json`) force on anyone adopting a base config. Covers #2041 (the array form was skipped entirely, so the generated config's `include` never entered the program and its ambient modules came back as TS2307).
